title: Daily Devotional #68
paragraphs: As I read Luke 24, I am reminded of the profound truth of your resurrection. Just as the women who went to the tomb on the first day of the week found it empty and encountered angels who proclaimed that you had risen, so too do I believe in your triumph over death.

It's incredible to think that the very same Jesus who died on the cross and was buried in a tomb is the very same Jesus who is alive and victorious today. It's a reminder that death is not the end, but merely a transition to a new and eternal life with you.

As I reflect on this chapter, I am struck by the reactions of the disciples when they first heard the news of your resurrection. They were initially filled with doubt and disbelief, but as they encountered you in the flesh and saw the scars on your hands and feet, their doubt turned to joy and amazement.

Lord, I pray that my own doubts and fears would be replaced by faith and trust in you. Help me to believe in your resurrection not just as a historical fact, but as a present reality that has the power to transform my life.
May the truth of your resurrection fill me with hope and joy, knowing that nothing is impossible for you and that you are always with me, even in the darkest moments of my life.
Thank you for the gift of your Son and the victory over death that he has won for us. May I always live in the light of his resurrection, and may my life be a reflection of his love and grace.
In Jesus' name I pray, Amen.
